headline: Data Science Intern | Computer Engineering Student
summary: Motivated Computer Engineering student at Kathmandu University with a focus on machine learning and predictive analytics. Proven ability to handle large datasets, perform exploratory data analysis, and develop ML models through academic research and industry internships. Eager to apply statistical modeling skills to solve real-world business challenges.

experiences.title: Data Science Intern
description: Assisted in building a recommendation engine using collaborative filtering techniques, improving user engagement by 12%.
Cleaned and pre-processed unstructured data from various sources using Python and Pandas for downstream ML tasks.
Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) and visualized trends using Matplotlib and Seaborn for internal stakeholder reports.

experiences.title: Research Assistant
description: Collaborated on a research project focusing on Natural Language Processing (NLP) for Nepali text sentiment analysis.
Implemented LSTM and GRU models using TensorFlow to classify sentiment in local news comments.
Managed data collection and labeling processes for a dataset of 10,000+ Nepali sentences.

experiences.title: Project Lead - Smart Traffic Management System
description: Developed a prototype for a real-time traffic density estimation system using OpenCV and YOLOv5.
Won the 'Best Use of AI' award among 40 participating teams.
Integrated a Flask-based dashboard to visualize live traffic statistics.
